sections.heading: Browse and buy
sections.body: Browse Monster Cores, Blueprints, Equipment, and Essences. Monster Cores, Blueprints, and Essences use buy and sell order books; unique equipment is listed as exact items. The Monster Cores category contains Lesser, Greater, and Primal Monster Cores. Sell unbound Blueprints from your inventory through the Blueprints category. Always review quantity, unit price, and total before confirming.

sections.heading: Equipment listings
sections.body: Filter exact equipment listings by identity, active style, minimum tier and minimum rank. Review the native and active styles and the item stats before buying. Only unbound equipment can be traded. Buying keeps it unbound; equipping it binds it to you.

sections.heading: Sell and place orders
sections.body: Sell selects eligible inventory items and either fills matching demand or creates a listing at your chosen price. Commodity markets can also accept buy orders. Restrictions shown by the action panel must be resolved before an order can be submitted.

sections.heading: My Orders and access
sections.body: My Orders contains your active listings and buy orders and provides their cancellation actions. Cinders committed to an order or items committed to a listing remain tied to that order until it fills or is cancelled. Guest accounts must be registered before using the Bazaar.
